title: Russian: B2 speaking in 10 months
basedOn: free resources checked in November 2026; the official ТРКИ-2 (TORFL-II) speaking format, sample tests and scoring tables from the SPbU testing centre; the official ТРКИ lexical minimums (A1 780, A2 about 1,300, B1 2,300, B2 about 5,100 words); the CEFR self-assessment grid; Paul Nation's four strands

projectSteps.label: Prepared
projectSteps.hint: Key words and a plan on one card (not a script), practised out loud 3 times

projectSteps.label: Recorded
projectSteps.hint: Recorded in one take, without reading

projectSteps.label: Feedback
projectSteps.hint: A native speaker (or an AI) corrected it, and the corrections are in your error log

stages.title: Placement and setup
stages.goal: Find your real starting level, set up the free tools, and record a ‘before’ sample so you can hear your progress later.
intro: If you already understand some Russian (common in Tashkent), don't restart from zero: take the placement tests, then in Stages 1–2 skip the Learn step for the topics you know, do a quick drill, and tick them.
One rule for the whole year: a topic is done when you've said it out loud in your own sentences, not when you've read about it.

items.text: I can introduce myself for 1 minute without notes: name, age, city, job, family, hobbies
I can ask and answer simple questions: who, what, where, when, how much
I can buy something, order food and ask the way in simple Russian
I can describe my day, my home and my work for 2 minutes in simple connected sentences
I can tell what I did last weekend and what I'll do next weekend
I can invite someone, accept or refuse, and agree on a time and a place
I can tell a story (a trip, an event, a mistake) with details, and say how I felt
I can keep a 20-minute conversation on familiar topics going without switching to English
I can say what I think about a film, a book or a plan, and give reasons
When I don't know a word, I can explain it another way and keep going
I can explain my work (data, GIS) for 5 minutes and answer questions about it
I can argue for and against a position on a social issue, with examples, and reach a conclusion
I can follow a fast conversation between native speakers and join in
I can retell a video or a news story in detail and say what I think about it
I can talk with a stranger for 15 minutes without strain on either side: they don't slow down or switch to English
Recorded a 2-minute answer to «Расскажи о себе и о своей жизни в Ташкенте», without notes. Keep every round's file and listen to them side by side.

Take a placement test: the [Russian for Free level test](https://www.russianforfree.com/Russian-level-test.php), then register on the [Pushkin Institute portal](https://pushkininstitute.ru/learn) (free self-study, interface in English or Uzbek) and take its level test. Write both results in the notes below.
Install Anki: [desktop and AnkiDroid](https://apps.ankiweb.net/) are free; on an iPhone use [AnkiWeb](https://ankiweb.net/) in the browser, since the iOS app is paid.
Add the Russian keyboard (ЙЦУКЕН layout) to your phone and computer, and type without looking within two weeks.

Bookmark the tools: [OpenRussian](https://en.openrussian.org/) (stress, declension and conjugation tables), [Russiangram](https://russiangram.com/) (adds stress marks to any text), [Forvo](https://forvo.com/languages/ru/) (native pronunciation) and [Reverso Context](https://context.reverso.net/translation/russian-english/) (words in real sentences).

Create free accounts on [Tandem](https://tandem.net/) and [HelloTalk](https://www.hellotalk.com/) (language exchange) and on [LangCorrect](https://langcorrect.com/) (native speakers correct your writing). Write your profile in Russian and English.
Fix your daily slots: one 2-hour block (or two 1-hour blocks), plus passive listening on the commute, at the gym or while cooking.
Write in the notes why you want Russian (work, family, travel, an exam) and your B2 date: your start date plus 10 months.

stages.title: Sounds and survival (A1)
stages.pace: ~2 h a day + 30 min of listening
stages.goal: Hear and make Russian sounds correctly, learn your first 800 words, and have your first real conversation in week 3.

sources.label: Между нами, lessons 1–4
sources.note: free first-year textbook from the University of Kansas, with audio; your main course for Stages 1–2, about one episode a day

sources.label: Pushkin Institute: A1 course
sources.note: free after registration; extra exercises on the same topics

sources.label: Russian with Max
sources.note: slow, clear videos for beginners

sources.label: Duolingo Russian
sources.note: optional 10-minute warm-up, never the main course

callouts: If you read Uzbek Cyrillic, the alphabet takes a day or two. Spend the time on what's different: ы, щ, hard vs soft consonants (мат / мать), and vowel reduction: an unstressed о sounds like а, so молоко́ sounds like «малако́».
Stress isn't marked in normal texts, and it moves (рука́, ру́ки). Learn every word with its stress: OpenRussian, Wiktionary and Russiangram show it.

items.title: Alphabet, reading and typing

sources.label: Russian for Free: how to read Russian
Master Russian: the alphabet with sounds

items.practice: Read 10 shop signs or menu items in Tashkent out loud, and type 20 words on the Russian keyboard.

items.title: Pronunciation: vowel reduction, hard and soft consonants, ы, stress
items.practice: Every day, shadow 1 minute of a Между нами dialogue. Once a week, record yourself reading it and compare with the original.

items.title: Intonation: statements vs yes/no questions (ИК-1, ИК-3)
items.practice: Say «Это твой телефон.» and «Это твой телефон?» so a listener hears the difference without seeing the punctuation.

items.title: Gender, plurals and possessives (мой, моя, моё, мои; чей?)
items.practice: Point at 15 things around you and say whose they are: «Это мой ноутбук. Это её сумка.»

items.title: Present tense: 1st and 2nd conjugation (читать, говорить, жить)
items.practice: Say 10 sentences about what you, your family and your colleagues do every day.

items.title: Adjectives and colours: какой? (новый, хорошая, большое)
items.practice: Describe your flat or your office in 8 sentences.

items.title: Prepositional case: where? (в / на + -е) and about (о + -е)
items.practice: Say where you live, work and study, and where 5 places in Tashkent are: «Я живу в Ташкенте, в Юнусабаде.»

items.title: Accusative of things: what do you read, watch, buy?
items.practice: Say what you read, watch, eat and buy in a week: «Я читаю новости, смотрю сериал, покупаю хлеб.»

items.title: Numbers 0–1000, prices, phone numbers and the time
items.practice: Ask for prices at a Tashkent bazaar or shop in Russian, and say your phone number and the time out loud until it's fast.

items.title: Survival phrases: greetings, ты / вы, please, sorry, asking for help

sources.label: Russian for Free: dialogues with audio

items.practice: Spend one day using Russian for every small exchange: shop, taxi, café, lift. In Tashkent you can start today.

items.title: Having and not having: у меня есть / у меня нет
items.practice: Say what you have and don't have: «У меня есть кот, но нет машины.»

items.title: Past tense (был, была, делал, делала)
items.practice: Tell what you did yesterday in 6 sentences.

items.text: Anki: 800 words, as short phrases with audio and stress, from the Между нами lessons and the [OpenRussian A1 list](https://en.openrussian.org/list/all?level=A1). The official A1 minimum is 780 words.

Learn the 8 phrases you'll need in every conversation: Как сказать по-русски…? Что это значит? Повторите, пожалуйста. Говорите медленнее, пожалуйста. Я не понял(а). Можно вопрос? Как это пишется? Я правильно сказал(а)?
Daily: shadow 1–2 minutes of audio. Listen once, then speak along at the same time, copying the rhythm and the melody.
Daily: 10 minutes of self-talk. Say out loud what you're doing: «Я готовлю завтрак. Я иду на работу.»
Week 3: your first language exchange on Tandem or HelloTalk, 15 minutes in Russian and 15 in English. Prepare 10 questions first.
Twice a week: 10 minutes of voice chat with a free AI assistant, using the prompt on the Speaking track.

stages.projectNote: Record a 1-minute self-introduction without notes: name, age, your district of Tashkent, job, family, hobbies, and why you're learning Russian. Get it corrected by an exchange partner or on [r/russian](https://www.reddit.com/r/russian/).

stages.title: Cases, past and future (A2)
stages.pace: ~2 h a day + 30–60 min of listening
stages.goal: Get all six cases into your speech, talk about the past and your plans, and hold a 30-minute exchange that's at least half in Russian.

sources.label: Между нами, lessons 5–9
sources.note: the same book: the rest of the cases, aspect, and the basics of motion verbs

sources.label: Pushkin Institute: A2 course
sources.note: free after registration

sources.label: Russian for Free: cases course
sources.note: with [grammar exercises](https://www.russianforfree.com/exercises.php)

sources.label: Master Russian: the six cases
sources.note: and the [case usage table](https://masterrussian.com/blcasetable.shtml)

callouts: Cases are where most learners stall. Don't start from the tables: learn one phrase per case that you'll say every day (в Ташкенте, у меня нет, мне нравится, с другом, к врачу), then build the table around it.

items.title: Accusative of people (вижу брата, жду коллегу)
items.practice: Say who you see, know, love and wait for: «Я жду коллегу. Я знаю его брата.»

items.title: Genitive: absence, quantity, ‘of’, and из, от, до, без, после, у
items.practice: Say where 5 things are from and what's missing: «Чай из Китая. В офисе нет кофе.»

items.title: Dative: кому? (мне нравится, мне нужно, мне 25 лет)
items.practice: Say what your family likes and needs, and how old everyone is: «Моему брату 30 лет. Ему нравится футбол.»

items.title: Instrumental: с кем? кем? (работать аналитиком, заниматься спортом)
items.practice: Say who you work and spend time with, and what you do in your free time: «Я работаю аналитиком данных. Я занимаюсь спортом.»

items.title: Aspect, first pass: делал or сделал? буду делать or сделаю?
items.practice: Tell what you did yesterday with 5 finished actions (perfective) and 5 habits or processes (imperfective).

items.title: Future and plans (буду + infinitive, the perfective future, собираюсь, хочу)
items.practice: Say 8 sentences about your plans for the weekend and for next year.

items.title: Motion verbs, part 1: идти / ходить, ехать / ездить; где, куда, откуда

sources.label: Real Russian Club: verbs of motion practice

items.practice: Describe how you get around: «Каждый день я езжу на работу на метро. Сейчас я еду домой.»

items.title: Imperative and requests (скажите, дайте, давайте…)
items.practice: Give a friend directions from Amir Temur Square (сквер Амира Темура) to your home, with imperatives.

items.title: Pronouns in all cases (меня, мне, мной…) and свой
items.practice: Answer 10 questions with a pronoun instead of the noun: «Ты звонил маме? — Да, я ей звонил.»

items.title: Comparatives and superlatives (больше, лучше, самый)
items.practice: Compare Tashkent with another city in 8 sentences: weather, prices, food, transport.

items.title: Numbers with nouns (2 часа, 5 часов) and the genitive plural
items.practice: Count things out loud all week: «два брата, пять минут, двадцать один год».

items.title: Connecting ideas: потому что, поэтому, когда, если, который
items.practice: Join 6 short sentences into 3 long ones with потому что, когда or который, then say them without looking.

items.text: Anki: 1,500 words in total (the official A2 minimum is about 1,300). From now on, add whole sentences from your listening and your error log, not single words.
One topic a week, 30–50 phrases each: food, transport, health, shopping, work, weather, free time, the city.
Two language exchanges a week, 30 minutes each, at least half in Russian.
Twice a week, 4/3/2: tell the same story (your day, your weekend) three times, in 4, 3 and 2 minutes, and record the last one.
Use Russian for one errand a day in Tashkent (shop, taxi, pharmacy, bank), and write down one phrase you were missing.
Work through the [Pushkin Institute A2 course](https://pushkininstitute.ru/basic) units on your weakest cases.
End of month 4: do the speaking part of the [SPbU A2 sample test (ТБУ)](https://testingcenter.spbu.ru/images/files/TBU.pdf), with a partner or an AI playing the examiner.

stages.projectNote: Talk for 3 minutes about your life in Tashkent: your day, your home and your work (present), last weekend (past) and your plans (future). Use at least four different cases on purpose.

stages.title: Aspect, motion and storytelling (B1)
stages.pace: ~2 h a day + 45–60 min of listening
stages.goal: Tell stories: master aspect and prefixed motion verbs, learn to explain words you don't know, and hold 30 minutes in Russian only.

sources.label: Pushkin Institute: B1 course
sources.note: free after registration; your main course for Stage 3

sources.label: Master Russian: aspect
sources.note: and [verbs of motion](https://masterrussian.com/verbs/verbs_of_motion.htm)

sources.label: Real Russian Club
sources.note: grammar explained in Russian, with subtitles

sources.label: Inklingo graded stories
sources.note: free stories with audio, A2–B1: read them as models for your own stories

callouts: Aspect and motion verbs are what separate B1 speakers from A2 speakers. Give them double time and expect mistakes for months: that's normal, and the error log will show them shrinking.

items.title: Aspect in depth: process vs result, once vs repeated, aspect after не and in commands
items.practice: Retell a short story twice: once as a chain of finished events (perfective), once as background and habits (imperfective).

items.title: Prefixed motion verbs (при-, у-, в-, вы-, за-, пере-, про-, под-, от-, до-)

sources.label: Russian with Max: motion verbs with prefixes

items.practice: Describe your route from home to work, step by step: «Я выхожу из дома, перехожу дорогу, захожу в магазин…»

items.title: More motion: on foot vs by transport, нести / везти / вести

sources.label: Be Fluent in Russian: verbs of motion

items.practice: Tell how you moved house or brought something heavy home.

items.title: Conditional and wishes (если бы…, я бы хотел, чтобы…)
items.practice: Answer for 2 minutes: «Что бы ты сделал, если бы у тебя был год свободного времени?»

items.title: Reported speech and questions (он сказал, что…; я спросил, придёт ли он)
items.practice: Retell a conversation you had today: «Коллега сказал, что… Я спросил, придёт ли он…»

items.title: Reflexive verbs (-ся) and друг друга
items.practice: Describe your morning with -ся verbs: «Я просыпаюсь, умываюсь, одеваюсь…»

items.title: кто-то, что-нибудь, никто, ничего не

sources.label: Be Fluent in Russian: что-то, кто-то

items.practice: Answer 10 questions with никогда, ничего or никуда: «Ты куда-нибудь ездил летом? — Нет, никуда не ездил.»

items.title: Time expressions (в понедельник, через час, неделю назад, за два часа, на неделю)
items.practice: Tell your life story with 10 time markers: «в 2015 году», «через год», «два года назад»…

items.title: Storytelling connectors (сначала, потом, вдруг, в итоге, оказалось, к счастью)
items.practice: Tell a 3-minute story about a trip or a funny event, with 8 connectors.

items.title: Explaining a word you don't know (это такая вещь, которой…; это человек, который…)
items.practice: Play ‘guess the word’ with a partner or an AI: explain 10 words without saying them («это такая вещь, которой режут хлеб»).

items.title: Opinions and feelings (мне кажется, по-моему, я рад, мне жаль, я в восторге)

sources.label: SPbU: the 20 intentions of the speaking test (PDF, slide «Интенции»)

items.practice: React to 10 headlines on [Kun.uz](https://kun.uz/ru) with an opinion phrase and one reason.

items.title: Intonation of emotion (ИК-2, ИК-5, ИК-7: surprise, delight, annoyance)
items.practice: Say «Какая погода!» as delight and as annoyance, and ask a partner which one they heard.

items.title: Short adjectives and states (должен, рад, готов, занят, прав)

sources.label: Be Fluent in Russian: short adjectives

items.practice: Say 6 sentences about how you feel and what you have to do this week.

items.text: Anki: 2,500 words in total (the official B1 minimum is 2,300).
Start a ‘my phrases’ deck: the 200 sentences you need for your own life (work, family, GIS, Tashkent), each one checked by a native speaker.
Two 45-minute conversations a week, Russian only for at least the first 30 minutes.
Weekly: write 150 words on [LangCorrect](https://langcorrect.com/), then read the corrected version out loud 3 times.
Weekly: retell a 3–5-minute Russian Progress or Real Russian Club video from memory, and record it.
Month 6: do the speaking part of the [SPbU B1 sample test (ТРКИ-1)](https://testingcenter.spbu.ru/images/files/TRKI-1.pdf).

stages.projectNote: Tell a 4-minute story (a trip, an event or a mistake) with aspect, motion verbs, time markers, connectors and how you felt. Do 4/3/2 on it before you record.

stages.title: Opinions and complex sentences (B1+ to B2)
stages.pace: ~2 h a day + 60 min of listening
stages.goal: Move from telling to arguing: give and defend opinions, compare options, and talk about your work for 5 minutes.

callouts: From B1+ the main gap is no longer grammar: it's words for abstract topics and the speed to use them. Spend more time on topic vocabulary and fluency, less on new rules.

items.title: Arguing: for and against, conceding, concluding (с одной стороны…, с другой стороны…; однако; таким образом)
items.practice: Talk for 3 minutes on «Работа из дома: плюсы и минусы»: 2 arguments for, 2 against, and a conclusion.

items.title: Agreeing, disagreeing, doubting, asking what someone means (я не совсем согласен; что вы имеете в виду?)
items.practice: With a partner, take turns making claims about Tashkent and reacting with a different intention each time: agree, doubt, be surprised, object.

items.title: Complex sentences: хотя, несмотря на то что, для того чтобы, вместо того чтобы, в то время как

sources.label: Mango Languages: conjunctions of reason, purpose and concession

items.practice: Answer 5 questions about your city with one complex sentence each.

items.title: Fillers that buy thinking time (ну, в общем, то есть, как бы сказать, дело в том, что)
items.practice: Collect 15 fillers from Easy Russian interviews and use 5 of them in your next conversation.

items.title: Short passive participles (закрыт, сделано, написан)
items.practice: Describe the state of things at work and in the city: «Магазин закрыт. Отчёт уже написан.»

items.title: Long participles and verbal adverbs (читающий, прочитанный, читая, прочитав): mostly to understand
items.practice: Find 10 in a news article and say each sentence again with который or когда.

items.title: Word formation: roots, prefixes and suffixes (-ость, -ние, -тель, пере-, недо-)
items.practice: Build word families from 5 roots (говор-, пис-, ход-, нов-, раб-) and use 3 words from each in sentences.

items.title: Numbers in all cases: dates, percentages, statistics (в 2025 году, на 15 процентов)
items.practice: Read 5 numbers from a [Gazeta.uz](https://www.gazeta.uz/ru/) article out loud: dates, percentages, prices.

items.title: Register: formal and informal speech, phone calls, polite complaints

sources.label: Be Fluent in Russian: formal vs informal

items.practice: Role-play two phone calls with a partner or an AI: booking an appointment, and complaining about a late delivery.

items.title: Your field in Russian: data, maps, GIS, AI
items.practice: Explain your current GIS or data project in 5 minutes, then answer 5 questions about it.

items.title: Idioms, proverbs and colloquial words
items.practice: Note 20 that you hear in films and interviews, with the situation they were used in.

items.text: Anki: 3,500 words in total. Add topic packs for the B2 discussion topics in Stage 5: work, education, the city, technology, family, health, ecology, culture, money, media.
Three conversations a week (exchange partners, a Russian-speaking friend or colleague, or AI voice chat), one of them 60 minutes long.
Weekly: a recorded 5-minute opinion talk on one of the Stage 5 discussion topics, after doing 4/3/2 on it.
Daily: read one Tashkent news story in Russian and sum it up out loud in 1 minute.
Every two weeks: watch a film (Mosfilm classics are free on YouTube) and retell the plot in 3 minutes.

stages.projectNote: Explain your work in 5 minutes: what you do, a project you're proud of, a problem you solved. Then let an exchange partner or an AI ask you 5 questions, and answer without notes.

stages.title: B2 fluency and the exam tasks
stages.pace: ~2 h a day + 60 min of listening
stages.goal: Make your speech fast, accurate and flexible: train all 15 tasks of the B2 (ТРКИ-2) speaking test and pass a full mock at 66% or more.
intro: The B2 speaking test (ТРКИ-2) has 15 tasks in 45 minutes, without a dictionary. Tasks 1–4: react to remarks, for example disagree using opposite evaluative words. Tasks 5–8: react with a given intention (agreement, doubt, delight, a suggestion) and explain why. Tasks 9–12: say lines with the intonation of an emotion. Task 13: watch a video clip, then describe the situation and the characters and explain why it happened (10 minutes to prepare, 3–5 to speak). Task 14: phone about an ad and ask about everything in detail (3 minutes to prepare, 3–5 to speak). Task 15: a 10–15-minute unprepared discussion of a social issue with the examiner.
To pass, you need 66% (96 of 145 points). Even if you never take the real exam, passing the mock is your proof of B2 speaking.

sources.note: the official format with sample tasks; see the part «Говорение»

groups.label: The 15 tasks, plus speed and accuracy

items.title: Tasks 1–4: disagree with opposite evaluative words (увлекательный → скучный)
items.practice: Daily: a partner or an AI says 10 positive sentences about a trip, a film or a café, and you disagree each time with an antonym.

items.title: Tasks 5–8: react with an intention and explain it (agree, doubt, delight, suggest, regret, reproach…)
items.practice: Make a card for each of the 20 intentions with 2 phrases on it, then react to random lines with a random card.

items.title: Tasks 9–12: the intonation of emotions (indignation, joy, disappointment, praise, surprise)
items.practice: Record the 4 sample lines with the requested emotions, and ask a native speaker which emotion they hear.

items.title: Task 13: describe a video: the situation, the characters, their motives, your explanation
items.practice: Twice a week: watch a 2–3-minute film scene, prepare for 10 minutes, speak for 4, and record it.

items.title: Task 14: phone about an ad (a job, a flat, a course, a competition)
items.practice: Take a real Russian-language ad from [OLX.uz](https://www.olx.uz/) (a flat or a job), write 8 questions in 3 minutes, and make the call with a partner or an AI playing the seller.

items.title: Task 15: a 10–15-minute discussion (opinion → details → reasons → comparison → example → guess → conclusion)
items.practice: Three times a week: a partner or an AI plays the examiner for 15 minutes on one topic from the list below.

items.title: Accuracy at speed: endings after numbers and prepositions, aspect, stress
items.practice: Record 5 minutes of free speech, transcribe 1 minute of it, fix every error, and put the fixes into Anki.

items.title: Fluency: more speed, fewer pauses
items.practice: Daily: shadow 2 minutes of a native-speed video. Weekly: 4/3/2 on a discussion topic.

groups.label: Discussion topics for task 15 (one a week)

items.text: Работа и карьера: работа мечты, удалённая работа, профессии будущего
Образование: онлайн-обучение, платное и бесплатное образование, учёба за границей
Город: транспорт, жильё, жизнь в мегаполисе и в деревне
Технологии: искусственный интеллект, соцсети, дети и смартфоны
Семья: роль родителей, отцы и дети, традиции
Здоровье: здоровый образ жизни, спорт, медицина
Экология: изменение климата, вода в Центральной Азии, переработка мусора
Культура: кино, книги, музеи, туризм, национальные традиции
Деньги: потребление, кредиты, благотворительность
СМИ: новости, фейки, реклама
Month 9, week 2: a full speaking mock with the [SPbU ТРКИ-2 sample](https://testingcenter.spbu.ru/images/files/TRKI-2.pdf): all 15 tasks, 45 minutes, recorded. A partner or an AI plays the examiner.
Score it with the scoring tables in the [SPbU speaking webinar](https://testingcenter.spbu.ru/images/webinars/webinar_9_test_rki.pdf), and give your 3 weakest tasks the next 4 weeks.
Month 10, week 2: a second full mock with the [Pushkin Institute ТРКИ-II sample](https://www.pushkin.institute/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/%D0%A2%D0%A0%D0%9A%D0%98-II.pdf). Target: 66% or more.
Optional: if you want a certificate, find an authorised ТРКИ test centre and book the B2 exam.

stages.title: Daily speaking system
stages.goal: Speaking is a skill you train, not knowledge you collect: 30–40 minutes of speaking a day, from week 1.
callouts: AI conversation prompt (the free voice mode of ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude): «Давай поговорим по-русски. Мой уровень — A2. Говори просто и медленно, задавай мне вопросы по одному, а после каждого моего ответа исправляй мои ошибки: сначала мой вариант, потом правильный.» Change A2 to your level at every self-assessment.

Language exchange rules: split the time 50/50, agree on how you want to be corrected (in the chat, at the end), prepare 5 questions before each call, and write 3 corrections into your error log after it.

groups.label: Habits (tick each one once you've kept it up 4 weeks in a row)

items.text: Shadowing, 10 minutes a day: listen once, then speak along with the audio at the same time, copying the rhythm and the melody.
Self-talk, 10 minutes a day: say what you're doing and thinking (walking, cooking, driving).
4/3/2 twice a week: give the same talk three times, in 4, 3 and 2 minutes. It's Paul Nation's fluency drill: the time pressure makes you faster without new language.
Error log: every correction you get goes into the stage's notes, and then into Anki as a sentence.
AI voice chat, 15 minutes a day, with the prompt above.
Record yourself once a week and listen back for 5 minutes: stress, endings, pauses.
First 15-minute language exchange (month 1)
10 minutes with a native speaker, all in Russian (months 2–3)
First phone call in Russian: book, order or ask about something (month 3)
30 minutes without a word of English (month 5)
Understood a joke and laughed at the right moment (month 6)
A 60-minute conversation in Russian only (months 7–8)
15 minutes with a stranger who didn't slow down or switch to English (months 9–10)
Use Russian for one errand a day: bazaar, taxi, pharmacy, bank, café.
Switch your phone and one social network to Russian.
Agree on a weekly ‘Russian only’ lunch or walk with a Russian-speaking friend or colleague.
Read Tashkent news in Russian ([Gazeta.uz](https://www.gazeta.uz/ru/), [Kun.uz](https://kun.uz/ru), [Spot.uz](https://www.spot.uz/ru/)) and retell one story to someone the same day.
Find a free Russian speaking club or meetup (universities, libraries, Telegram groups, [Conversation Exchange](https://www.conversationexchange.com/)) and go at least once.

stages.title: Listening and reading ladder
stages.when: All year: 30 min focused + passive time every day
stages.goal: You can only say what you've heard many times. Climb from slow learner content to native speed: about 300 hours of listening in 10 months.
callouts: Two kinds of listening. Focused (25–30 minutes, block 3 of the day): with a transcript or subtitles; pause, repeat, shadow. Passive (commute, gym, chores): something you understand 70–90% of, without pausing. [Language Reactor](https://www.languagereactor.com/) shows Russian and English subtitles together on YouTube for free.
Move up a level when you understand about 80% of the current one without subtitles.

stages.title: Recorded speaking projects
stages.when: One per stage, and a final talk in month 10
stages.goal: Each stage ends with one recorded talk. Keep every file: hearing month 1 next to month 10 is the best proof of progress there is.
callouts: Record on your phone, in one take, without reading. Prepare key words on one card, not a script: B2 is about speaking freely, not reciting.

items.proves: B1+: explaining, complex sentences, unprepared answers
